title: The US SEC and CFTC announce an agreement to coordinate operations where their duties overlap, including building a combined crypto oversight framework (Jesse Hamilton/CoinDesk)
summary: Jesse Hamilton / CoinDesk: The US SEC and CFTC announce an agreement to coordinate operations where their duties overlap, including building a combined crypto oversight framework — The two agencies sealed their memorandum of understanding to link the parts of their work that overlap, and coordinated crypto oversight is among the top goals.
